verses.1: A Canticle in steps. When the Lord turned back the captivity of Zion, we became like those who are consoled.
verses.2: Then our mouth was filled with gladness and our tongue with exultation. Then they will say among the nations: “The Lord has done great things for them.”
verses.3: The Lord has done great things for us. We have become joyful.
verses.4: Convert our captivity, O Lord, like a torrent in the south.
verses.5: Those who sow in tears shall reap in exultation.
verses.6: When departing, they went forth and wept, sowing their seeds.
verses.7: But when returning, they will arrive with exultation, carrying their sheaves. [ Psalm 126 ] (127)
